applied.resolution: Recast the opening, negation thesis, and conclusion as a strong working interpretation grounded in the selected witness and convergent themes, with explicit cross-witness limits.
Presented the strongest non-substantial true-self reading before limiting the rejection to enduring self-identical entities and noting incomplete early-commentarial adjudication.
Relabeled the three movements as a base-witness heuristic and required passage-level checks of witness, syntax, speaker, and pragmatic function.
Changed the conventional-efficacy claim from a categorical trilemma to a risk of substantialism when efficacy is treated as self-grounded, while acknowledging pragmatic conventionalism.
Replaced decisive behavioral classification with a provisional pragmatic safety screen and added longitudinal, clinical, and safeguarding limits.
Marked the workplace tests as a normative governance screen derived from benefit, co-option, and right-livelihood evidence, not validated necessary or sufficient criteria.
Restored ritual and material reception to the concluding synthesis and stated that the responsive-action lens is not exhaustive of the sutra's historical life.
Added the causal and grammatical nimitta/saṃjñā account of objectifying conception ceasing without annihilating a referent, with calibrated confidence and citations.
Added concrete worked contrasts showing how grammar, ontology, and pragmatic redirection alter nihilistic or essentialist readings.
Expanded the reception chain from the text's own transmission script through communal performance and material form to the anti-transactional safeguard.
Made the redactional uncertainty operational by stating the consequences of broad early versus late or marginal attestation.
Added the intra-textual sequence from self through Buddha marks, attainment, and selflessness that prevents replacement essences.
Added the failed objective-attention mechanism check, the heterogeneous 8.3 percent adverse-event estimate, practice-intensity distinctions, and the self-optimization category error.
Added the bidirectional definition of adaptive nonattachment, preliminary bypass evidence, and limits on inferring integration from calmness or spiritual identity.
Marked the workplace governance criteria as a normative synthesis, made the unmeasured-structure reasoning explicit, and added the bribery example as a review safeguard.
Added the preliminary emotion-identification, communication, and anger-regulation mechanism and derived the marriage conflict practice explicitly from it.
Added the Asaṅga commentary case with Sanskrit ablative and causal relations plus Yijing and Bodhiruci renderings, explicitly as a contested illustration rather than a final solution.
Added a balanced co-option versus right-livelihood business subsection with constructive institutional design, critical scholarship, and explicit normative status.
Added nursing review evidence on compassion satisfaction, burnout, secondary traumatic stress, care sustainability, and organizational duty.
Added the ADHD parent-child study showing parent-rated improvement without substantial teacher-rated effects and specified multi-informant safeguards.
Added general and self-specific nonattachment evidence while preserving association-level, temporal, construct, and soteriological limits.
Labeled the identity, emotion, workplace, marriage, interpersonal, and final behavioral frameworks as contemporary syntheses and attached source-to-inference provenance and limits.
Narrowed all three audited absences to transparent local-corpus or cited-source boundaries rather than making undocumented global absence claims.
Added two compact translation contrasts from the available early-commentarial study and disclosed that the local corpus lacks a complete synoptic apparatus.
Added a dedicated career subsection covering vocation, promotion, rejection, job loss, feedback, ambition, ethical compromise, exploitation, and role identity.
Added an operational business-practices subsection covering governance, labor, pricing, marketing, customers, contracts, suppliers, investment, externalities, and accountability.
Added an image map for cutting, raft, bodily marks and quantitative comparisons, and the closing conditioned-phenomena similes, including misuse and witness cautions.
